title: Carlisle Evans, pianist with Tony Catalano
summary: Carlisle Evans succeeded Stacy with Catalano's band and led his own for a while.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Carlisle Evans, yes, he was out of Davenport, Iowa. He played on the boat with Tony Catalano. He was the piano player with Tony Catalano at one time, and he succeeded, uh, Stacy, I believe, Carlisle Evans. They wanted to have a band of his own for a few years.
Fred Fleck was the name of the band. I'm not sure. I don't remember his name.
It's hard for me to keep all these names straight.
I don't remember so many names, but I remember Carlisle Evans because he was a piano player. He was a good one.
